occurrences.englishText: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
